import cadquery as cq
slope_angle_deg = 45.0
inner = 10.96
outer = 27.4
half_w = 10.96
run = outer - inner
rise = run * math.tan(math.radians(slope_angle_deg))
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polyline([[10.96, 10.96], [27.4, 10.96], [27.4, -10.96], [10.96, -10.96], [10.96, -27.4], [-10.96, -27.4], [-10.96, -10.96], [-27.4, -10.96], [-27.4, 10.96], [-10.96, 10.96], [-10.96, 27.4], [10.96, 27.4]])
    .close()
    .extrude(7.4)
)
show_object(result)

import math
import cadquery as cq
slope_angle_deg = 45.0
inner = 10.96
outer = 27.4
half_w = 10.96
run = outer - inner
rise = run * math.tan(math.radians(slope_angle_deg))
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polyline([[10.96, 10.96], [27.4, 10.96], [27.4, -10.96], [10.96, -10.96], [10.96, -27.4], [-10.96, -27.4], [-10.96, -10.96], [-27.4, -10.96], [-27.4, 10.96], [-10.96, 10.96], [-10.96, 27.4], [10.96, 27.4]])
    .close()
    .extrude(7.4)
)
wedge_px = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .polyline([(inner, 0.0), (outer, 0.0), (outer, rise)])
    .close()
    .extrude(half_w, both=True)
)
wedge_nx = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .polyline([(-inner, 0.0), (-outer, 0.0), (-outer, rise)])
    .close()
    .extrude(half_w, both=True)
)
wedge_py = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .polyline([(inner, 0.0), (outer, 0.0), (outer, rise)])
    .close()
    .extrude(half_w, both=True)
)
wedge_ny = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .polyline([(-inner, 0.0), (-outer, 0.0), (-outer, rise)])
    .close()
    .extrude(half_w, both=True)
)
result = result.cut(wedge_px).cut(wedge_nx).cut(wedge_py).cut(wedge_ny)
for cx, cy, sx, sy in [
    ((inner + outer) / 2, 0, run, 2 * half_w),
    (-(inner + outer) / 2, 0, run, 2 * half_w),
    (0, (inner + outer) / 2, 2 * half_w, run),
    (0, -(inner + outer) / 2, 2 * half_w, run),
]:
    arm = cq.Workplane("XY").box(sx, sy, 7.4, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((cx, cy, 0))
    result = result.union(arm)
result = result.clean()
show_object(result)
